name: Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups (GTKVN)
benefit: - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹60,000/- for eligible small businesses.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** 95% of the project/business cost is covered; 5% contribution is to be made by the beneficiary.- **Repayment Term:** 48 equal monthly installments (4 years), including interest.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a member of a Self Help Group (SHG). 1. The applicant should belong to the Thakor or Koli caste. 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have relevant experience in the proposed trade/business field. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan allocation is reserved for those with family income up to ₹1,50,000/-.
